chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Abstain from the world so that Allāh may show you its real evils, and do not be neglectful because (in any case) you will not be neglected.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of detaching from the world according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this saying from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links asceticism (zuhd) directly to divine illumination, suggesting that detachment from worldly distractions allows God to reveal the 'naked truths' or hidden flaws of material life. The warning against negligence underscores the Shia concept of divine watchfulness (muraqabah), where spiritual inattention invites accountability, a theme deeply resonant with the eschatological reflections in Surah Al-Imran and Surah Az-Zumar.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 391. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Abstain from the world so that Allāh may show you its real evils and do not be neglectful because (in any case) you will not be neglected.
